name: Gyro Bell
en: Plucked lattice with strong gyroscopic coupling: split modes beat slowly like a struck bell.
zh: 强陀螺耦合的拨奏晶格：简并模态被劈裂，像敲击的钟一样缓慢拍频。

name: Counter-Spin Bell
en: Chirality reversed: the same bell, but the partials beat the other way around the flake.
zh: 手性反向：同一口钟，泛音沿雪花反方向拍动。

name: Glass Gong
en: Wide on-site gap stretches the partials; long, shimmering gong tail.
zh: 宽的在位能隙拉伸泛音列；长而闪烁的锣尾。

name: Toy Carillon
en: 8x8 flake: few modes, clear inharmonic chime; the cheapest bell in the bank.
zh: 8x8 小雪花：模态少，清晰的非谐和钟声；库里最省 CPU 的钟。

name: Cathedral Gyro 32
en: 32x32 flake: dense mode cloud, slow chorus of split partials.
zh: 32x32 大雪花：稠密的模态云，劈裂泛音形成缓慢的合唱。

name: Honeycomb Harp
en: Soft plucks on the honeycomb; mild chirality keeps the decay slightly swirling.
zh: 蜂窝上的柔和拨奏；轻微手性让余音略带旋动。

name: Snowflake Koto
en: Narrow pickups near the centre: nasal, koto-like attack with a quick bloom.
zh: 拾音点贴近中心：鼻音般、类似古筝的起音，随后快速绽开。

name: Felt Lattice
en: Low tone and short decay: muted, felt-covered plucks.
zh: 低音调、短衰减：像包了毛毡的闷音拨奏。

name: Bent Tine
en: HQ gap plus nonlinearity: tine-like pluck whose pitch bends as it rings out.
zh: HQ 能隙加非线性：像音叉齿的拨奏，振幅衰减时音高随之弯曲。

name: Defect Kalimba
en: A row of heavy defects traps modes in pockets: short, tuned, kalimba-like hits.
zh: 一排重缺陷把模态困在小腔里：短促、有音高、像拇指琴的敲击。

name: Low Mallets
en: Low tone, scattered defects: woody marimba-ish mallets.
zh: 低音调、散布缺陷：带木质感的马林巴式槌击。

name: Shard Clave
en: Dense random defects and fast damping: dry, glassy clicks with pitch.
zh: 密集随机缺陷与快速阻尼：干脆、玻璃质、带音高的咔哒声。

name: Ring Cavity Tom
en: A ring of defects forms a drum-head cavity; the voice inside booms.
zh: 缺陷围成的圆环像鼓皮腔体；腔内的声部低沉轰鸣。

name: Chiral Cello
en: A bowed saw through a low-tuned chiral flake: woody, slightly twisted cello body.
zh: 弓擦锯齿波穿过低调手性雪花：木质、略带扭转感的大提琴腔体。

name: Rusty Bow
en: High quartic nonlinearity: the bow scrapes, partials crowd and growl.
zh: 高四次非线性：弓在刮擦，泛音拥挤并发出低吼。

name: Viola Gyre
en: Mid register; strong chirality pulls the bowed tone into a rotating chorus.
zh: 中音区；强手性把弓擦音拉成旋转的合唱感。

name: Glass Harmonica
en: HQ gap and a high tone: wet-finger glass, pure and slightly unstable.
zh: HQ 能隙加高音调：湿指摩擦玻璃般纯净，略带不稳定。

name: Sul Ponticello
en: Pickups spread to the rim: thin, glassy bowing near the bridge.
zh: 拾音点外移至边缘：贴近琴码的纤细玻璃质弓音。

name: Rim Rider
en: Maximum chirality: the bowed energy rides the flake's rim, pickups at the edge hear it circle.
zh: 最大手性：弓擦能量沿雪花边缘传播，边缘拾音点听到它绕圈。

name: Mirror Rim
en: The same edge, counter-rotating, with crosstalk folding the two pickups together.
zh: 同一条边缘反向旋转，串扰把两个拾音点折叠在一起。

name: Edge Chime
en: Plucked at full chirality: chime partials that keep travelling around the rim as they fade.
zh: 满手性拨奏：钟声泛音在衰减时仍沿边缘行进。

name: Ember Field
en: Plucks kick off morphogen waves that briefly fan the lattice like embers, then cool.
zh: 拨奏激发形态场波，像余烬被短暂扇旺，随后冷却。

name: Static Bloom
en: Fast Barkley medium (short tau): crackling blooms of grain after every note.
zh: 快速 Barkley 介质（短 tau）：每个音符后都绽开噼啪作响的颗粒。

name: Slow Tide
en: Slow medium (long tau) under a bow: the timbre swells and recedes in tides.
zh: 慢速介质（长 tau）配合弓擦：音色像潮汐一样涨落。

name: Nerve Net
en: HQ potential + a twitchy medium: plucks fire nerve-like volleys across the flake.
zh: HQ 势加敏感介质：拨奏在雪花上激发神经脉冲般的连发。

name: Spiral Drone
en: A seeded spiral wave turns slowly in the medium, sweeping the bowed drone's colour.
zh: 介质中植入的螺旋波缓慢旋转，扫动弓擦长音的音色。

name: Low Orbit
en: Very low tone, near-critical Life: a sub-heavy drone that hangs on after release.
zh: 极低音调、接近临界的 Life：释放后仍久久不散的厚重低频长音。

name: Halo Choir
en: HQ gap, wide pickups, slow morphogen: airy, vowel-like choir pad.
zh: HQ 能隙、宽拾音、慢形态场：空灵、带元音感的合唱铺底。

name: Big Spiral 32
en: 32x32 flake with a seeded spiral: a slowly rotating, dense drone.
zh: 32x32 雪花加螺旋种子：缓慢旋转的稠密长音。
origin: 26 Big Spiral 32 (rework: sub-critical Life, HQ fast at 32x32)

name: Morphogen Tapestry
en: Two morphogen sources collide; the bowed tone slowly reweaves its partials.
zh: 两个形态场源相撞；弓擦音慢慢重新编织泛音。

name: Turing Bells
en: Plucked bells over a spiral-seeded medium: each strike lands on a different texture.
zh: 在植入螺旋的介质上拨奏的钟：每一次敲击落在不同的纹理上。

name: Breathing Glass
en: Bowed high glass whose brightness breathes with the medium's slow waves.
zh: 弓擦高音玻璃，其明亮度随介质慢波呼吸。

name: Edge Shimmer
en: In-gap bands ride the one-way chiral edge: a bright, dispersed ring beside the dry signal.
zh: 能隙内频带沿单向手性边缘传播：在干声旁形成明亮、色散的鸣响。

name: Low Edge Rumble
en: Edge tuned low: a dark, slowly dispersing rumble under kick and bass.
zh: 边缘调低：在底鼓与贝斯下方缓慢色散的暗沉低鸣。

name: Glass Corridor
en: HQ gap lifts the edge band: long, glassy corridor with a high, pure tail.
zh: HQ 能隙抬高边缘频带：长而透明的玻璃走廊，尾音高而纯。

name: Grit Edge
en: Quartic nonlinearity on the edge: transients come back crunchy and pitch-smeared.
zh: 边缘上的四次非线性：瞬态返回时带着颗粒感与音高涂抹。

name: Pinhole Edge
en: Defects pinch the rim: the edge wave scatters at the pinholes into comb-like echoes.
zh: 缺陷夹窄了边缘：边缘波在针孔处散射成梳状回声。

name: Tiny Edge 8
en: 8x8 flake: a short rim, tight flutter of edge echoes; the lightest FX.
zh: 8x8 小雪花：短边缘、紧凑的边缘回声颤动；最轻量的效果器。

name: Long Edge 32
en: 32x32 rim: four times the path, so the dispersion stretches into a slow, sweeping tail.
zh: 32x32 边缘：路径长四倍，色散被拉成缓慢扫动的尾音。

name: Freeze Halo
en: Partial freeze around a defect ring: a soft halo that hangs on after each hit.
zh: 缺陷环周围的部分冻结：每次敲击后悬停的柔和光晕。
origin: 09 Freeze Halo (rework: finite tail by default)

name: Crystal Cage
en: Heavy defect cavity: frozen modes stay trapped inside and ring as a crystal chord.
zh: 重缺陷腔体：冻结的模态被困在腔内，像水晶和弦般鸣响。

name: Soft Hold
en: Gentle freeze with no defects: the whole flake sustains a soft, blurred hold.
zh: 无缺陷的轻度冻结：整片雪花维持柔和、模糊的延音。

name: Shattered Ice
en: Scattered defects + HQ: a frozen field full of grainy, glinting partials.
zh: 散布缺陷加 HQ：充满颗粒与闪光泛音的冻结场。

name: Spiral Lock
en: Defects laid along a spiral arm: the frozen tone winds outwards as it fades.
zh: 缺陷沿螺旋臂排布：冻结的音色在消退时向外盘旋。

name: Glacier 32
en: 32x32 freeze: a vast, slow glacier of held modes with a line of fault defects.
zh: 32x32 冻结：带一条断层缺陷的巨大、缓慢的冻结模态冰川。

name: Bulk Smear
en: Low chirality bulk body: a short, smeared resonance that thickens drums.
zh: 低手性体态腔体：短而涂抹的共振，让鼓更厚实。

name: Honeycomb Room
en: Medium decay, wide pickups: the flake as a small warm wooden room.
zh: 中等衰减、宽拾音：把雪花当作一间温暖的小木屋。

name: Gyro Chamber
en: Strong chirality in the bulk: reflections swirl and the stereo image rotates.
zh: 体态中的强手性：反射盘旋，立体声像随之旋转。

name: Dark Plate
en: Low tone, long decay: a dark plate-like bloom under vocals or keys.
zh: 低音调、长衰减：垫在人声或键盘下方的暗色板式混响。

name: Ember Echo
en: Hits fan morphogen waves; the echo glows a little louder before it cools.
zh: 敲击扇起形态场波；回声在冷却前会微微变亮。

name: Static Gate
en: Fast medium: every transient leaves a short burst of crackle, then silence.
zh: 快速介质：每个瞬态留下短暂的噼啪声，随后归于寂静。

name: Living Edge
en: Edge disperser with near-critical Life: the rim ring swells after the input.
zh: 接近临界 Life 的边缘色散器：输入之后边缘鸣响会膨胀。

name: Spark Chamber
en: HQ bulk with a twitchy medium: sparks fly off transients in the high band.
zh: HQ 体态配敏感介质：瞬态在高频带上迸出火花。

name: Breathing Edge
en: Morphogen waves modulate the edge's damping: the shimmer breathes on its own.
zh: 形态场波调制边缘阻尼：鸣响自行呼吸。

name: Tidal Freeze
en: A slow medium modulates a partial freeze: held tones ebb and flow.
zh: 慢速介质调制部分冻结：保持的音像潮水般起落。

name: Turing Smear
en: A spiral wave turns in the medium; the body's colour rotates with it.
zh: 介质中旋转的螺旋波带动腔体音色一同旋转。

name: Chiral Drift
en: Morphogen modulates chirality itself: the edge band drifts in pitch and direction.
zh: 形态场直接调制手性：边缘频带在音高与方向上漂移。
